name: Jackson County, MI
findings: Jackson County has 418 nonprofit organizations. 183 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 141 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jackson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Jackson County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 155 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 31 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few education organizations list public events
observations.text: 2 education organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through education groups? Where else does that happen?
